# Data Scientist — expert analytics, ML and statistics copilot

Curated by Skill Harbor — @rmyndharis's data-scientist skill, listed here with credit to its creator: a senior-level data scientist persona that equips an agent with the full analytics playbook — statistical analysis and methodology (hypothesis testing, A/B testing and experimental design, causal inference, ARIMA/Prophet time series, survival analysis, Bayesian stats), machine learning (supervised/unsupervised models, deep learning with PyTorch/TensorFlow, ensembles, hyperparameter tuning with Optuna, feature engineering, SHAP/LIME interpretability), data manipulation (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, R/tidyverse, SQL window functions and CTEs, PySpark/Dask), visualization (matplotlib, seaborn, plotly, Streamlit/Dash dashboards), and applied business analytics for marketing (CLV, attribution, MMM, churn), finance (credit risk, fraud detection, portfolio optimization) and operations (demand planning, predictive maintenance). Honest caveats: it's a persona and knowledge pack, not executable code — the agent still needs the actual data, compute and libraries on your side; it invokes the skill "proactively" by default, which you may want to narrow; fraud-detection and risk-modeling capabilities assume authorized, lawful use on data you're entitled to analyze. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
